decision: finalizer aborts the pass (publishes nothing, logs abort) when any relay read reached EOSE on zero relays; relay.js gains queryRelays -> {events, answered}, fetchEvents wraps it

decision: decide(entry, now, finalizerPubkey): done only on a Bitcoin 1040 signed by this finalizer's key; others' 1040s ignored; dry-run reads the key if present (else none counts)
why: the finalizer can't verify Bitcoin headers, so a forged 1040 by anyone could block a Claim forever; our own 1040s are the only ones we know are real
evidence: commit e5e43fb; unit test 'a valid Bitcoin 1040 signed by any other key is ignored' failed before (done)

decision: fallback stamp needs the Claim's Run (e tag id) on the relays and passing checkRun (run.mjs queries Runs by ids; indexEvents attaches entry.run); oldest-first cap of 20 stamps per pass, overflow logged; STAMP_AFTER_S 120 -> 600
why: any well-formed Claim cost a calendar request and an ots-pending each, unbounded; 10 min instead of 120 s because the phone's own pending carries the earlier calendar time (better for k-of-n ordering) and a slow phone on bad signal can take minutes, while the finalizer only needs to catch pages that never stamped; note checkRun accepts any signer, so the cap is the real bound
evidence: commit 670e4e1; unit + integration tests (run not found, not-a-Run, 23 Claims -> 20 then 23) failed before; mutation checkRun->verifyEvent caught

decision: each pass logs 'expiring <id> N h old, no 1040 yet; leaves the 7-day window in M h' for every Claim 6-7 days old not done by our key
why: Claims silently fell out of the since: now-7d read; journald now shows which ones and when; repeats every pass in the last day (~288 lines per stuck Claim) so a stuck Claim is visible, not a one-shot line a missed run could skip
evidence: commit ccd455b; integration test failed before (no expiring line)
